no_balloon_tips=yes	windows-xp	+rem USOS profile: Explorer settings for new users (Default User hive).
no_balloon_tips=yes	windows-xp	+set USOS_PD=
no_balloon_tips=yes	windows-xp	+set USOS_DU=
no_balloon_tips=yes	windows-xp	+for /f "tokens=2*" %%A in ('reg query "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\ProfileList" /v ProfilesDirectory ^| find "REG_"') do call set "USOS_PD=%%B"
no_balloon_tips=yes	windows-xp	+for /f "tokens=2*" %%A in ('reg query "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\ProfileList" /v DefaultUserProfile ^| find "REG_"') do set "USOS_DU=%%B"
no_balloon_tips=yes	windows-xp	+if not defined USOS_DU set "USOS_DU=Default User"
no_balloon_tips=yes	windows-xp	+reg load HKU\USOSDEF "%USOS_PD%\%USOS_DU%\NTUSER.DAT" >> "%USOS_LOG%" 2>&1
no_balloon_tips=yes	windows-xp	+reg add "HKU\USOSDEF\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced" /v EnableBalloonTips /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f >> "%USOS_LOG%" 2>&1
no_balloon_tips=yes	windows-xp	+reg add "HKU\USOSDEF\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Applets\Tour" /v RunCount /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f >> "%USOS_LOG%" 2>&1
no_balloon_tips=yes	windows-xp	+reg unload HKU\USOSDEF >> "%USOS_LOG%" 2>&1

show_extensions=yes	windows-xp	+rem USOS profile: Explorer settings for new users (Default User hive).
show_extensions=yes	windows-xp	+set USOS_PD=
show_extensions=yes	windows-xp	+set USOS_DU=
show_extensions=yes	windows-xp	+for /f "tokens=2*" %%A in ('reg query "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\ProfileList" /v ProfilesDirectory ^| find "REG_"') do call set "USOS_PD=%%B"
show_extensions=yes	windows-xp	+for /f "tokens=2*" %%A in ('reg query "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\ProfileList" /v DefaultUserProfile ^| find "REG_"') do set "USOS_DU=%%B"
show_extensions=yes	windows-xp	+if not defined USOS_DU set "USOS_DU=Default User"
show_extensions=yes	windows-xp	+reg load HKU\USOSDEF "%USOS_PD%\%USOS_DU%\NTUSER.DAT" >> "%USOS_LOG%" 2>&1
show_extensions=yes	windows-xp	+reg add "HKU\USOSDEF\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced" /v HideFileExt /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f >> "%USOS_LOG%" 2>&1
show_extensions=yes	windows-xp	+reg unload HKU\USOSDEF >> "%USOS_LOG%" 2>&1

show_hidden=yes	windows-xp	+rem USOS profile: Explorer settings for new users (Default User hive).
show_hidden=yes	windows-xp	+set USOS_PD=
show_hidden=yes	windows-xp	+set USOS_DU=
show_hidden=yes	windows-xp	+for /f "tokens=2*" %%A in ('reg query "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\ProfileList" /v ProfilesDirectory ^| find "REG_"') do call set "USOS_PD=%%B"
show_hidden=yes	windows-xp	+for /f "tokens=2*" %%A in ('reg query "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\ProfileList" /v DefaultUserProfile ^| find "REG_"') do set "USOS_DU=%%B"
show_hidden=yes	windows-xp	+if not defined USOS_DU set "USOS_DU=Default User"
show_hidden=yes	windows-xp	+reg load HKU\USOSDEF "%USOS_PD%\%USOS_DU%\NTUSER.DAT" >> "%USOS_LOG%" 2>&1
show_hidden=yes	windows-xp	+reg add "HKU\USOSDEF\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced" /v Hidden /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f >> "%USOS_LOG%" 2>&1
show_hidden=yes	windows-xp	+reg unload HKU\USOSDEF >> "%USOS_LOG%" 2>&1
